Delete this item?

Log out of VEXA?

Your closet and results stay safe. You can sign back in anytime.

Delete account forever?

Your photos, closet, outfits and AI results will be permanently erased. This can't be undone.

Replace try-on photo?

Your current photo will be archived. New photos go through a quick quality check.

Replace item photo?

Re-shoot this piece for cleaner try-on results. The item's details stay unchanged.

Generate again?

We'll re-render this look with the same photo and clothes. Small details may vary.
